services.name: Backwater Kayak Adventure Tour
services.desc: Join our kayak tour to enjoy the natural beauty of Southwest Florida. Paddle to remote bays, mangrove rivers, and peaceful waterways with our experienced guide. Our adventure will start with basic kayak instruction on land followed by water practice so you will be comfortable with your tour equipment. When you’re ready, off we go! We will be the only tour group in this area due to limited launch access. We will introduce you to the flora & fauna and the beautiful waterways we call home. Memories of dolphins, maybe rays and manatees, and many birds will dance in your head for years to come. We will paddle into Tarpon Bay and navigate the passes between mangrove islands. Going around Stingray

blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats, kayaks, and paddle boards to explore the backwaters, mangrove rivers, and islands near Marco Island and Naples. The marina offers boat docks for rent and guided kayak tours through local waterways. Staff provide safety equipment and orientation for boat rentals, and can offer tips on local fishing and wildlife spotting.
